auxiliary_suffix.reason: Ranks 19-26 contain only recognized antioxidant and fragrance/allergen auxiliaries. Antioxidants at 19 and 20 count as one function; fragrance at 21 supplies the independent second function. The film/viscosity-capable modified glyceride at 18 prevents an earlier suffix.

counter_signal: Hybrid is the strongest rival because several intact oils plus modified glycerides can contribute materially to the retained system.
base.reason: The continuous early ester/alkane emollient sequence, with supporting emollient solvent at rank 6, positively establishes the principal carrier backbone. Almond, castor, sunflower seed and soybean oils are all counted, but their presence does not establish a co-principal botanical backbone. Angelica seed preparation remains unresolved and is not assigned an intact fixed-oil prior.
base.unresolved: Amounts, grades and Angelica seed preparation are unavailable; exact functions for ranks 8, 11 and 13 are unassessed.

counter_signal: Medium: retained palmitate/emollient contributions, rich-prior castor oil and the modified glyceride film/viscosity route could jointly produce greater coating burden.
Rich: castor plus hydrogenated coco-glycerides supplies a substantive richer counter-signal, but neither their order nor presence establishes principal structural dominance.
weight.reason: B1/B4 favor the coherent ester/alkane distribution architecture with mostly light-prior supporting botanical oils. Castor and modified glycerides are explicitly retained as heavier signals, but there is no affirmative evidence that their structural/conditioning contribution outweighs this carrier architecture; B6 cannot be invoked from a single structurant or richer oil. Light here is a weak sensory-load hypothesis, not an evaporation or negligible-residue claim.
weight.unresolved: No amounts, ester/alkane grades, structurant grade, equal-dose sensory comparison or measured film load. Unassessed extracts/oils and unresolved Angelica preparation remain source gaps; generic emollience alone does not measure lightness.

counter_signal: The intact botanical oils may have unmeasured uptake; no negative inference follows from lacking an admitted positive anchor.
penetration_potential.reason: A coherent principal synthetic emollient carrier architecture, with an additional modified-glyceride film route, predominates over the supporting intact oils. This supports surface-led as a low-confidence architectural estimate, without converting plant derivatives to coconut penetration evidence or asserting that all emollients cannot penetrate.
penetration_potential.unresolved: No exact-formula uptake evidence or carrier ratios; botanical preparation gaps and blend/laboratory-to-retail extrapolation remain unresolved.
